seo.title: Reown - WalletConnect Protocol
seo.description: Reown (WalletConnect) provides the protocol for connecting wallets to dApps. Universal wallet connection with AppKit UI.
seo.keywords: Reown, WalletConnect, wallet connection, AppKit, Web3Modal, dApp protocol

overview:
Reown (formerly WalletConnect) provides the protocol for connecting wallets to dApps. Their standard enables any wallet to connect to any app—the universal wallet connection layer.

WalletConnect v2 introduced multi-chain support, session management, and improved security. It's the standard used by most mobile wallets and many dApps for remote wallet connections.

Reown also offers AppKit (formerly Web3Modal), a wallet connection UI that supports WalletConnect and many other connection methods. The company behind the protocol now offers full-stack solutions.

1.question: What is Reown?
1.answer: Reown (formerly WalletConnect) provides the protocol connecting wallets to dApps. When you scan a QR code with your mobile wallet, that's WalletConnect. They also offer AppKit for connection UI.

2.question: What is WalletConnect?
2.answer: WalletConnect is the open protocol for wallet-dApp connections. It works across wallets and apps—a universal standard. V2 supports multi-chain and improved security.

3.question: What is AppKit?
3.answer: AppKit (formerly Web3Modal) is a wallet connection UI component. Supports WalletConnect, injected wallets, and others. Drop-in solution for connecting wallets in dApps.

4.question: Is WalletConnect free?
4.answer: The protocol is free and open source. Reown offers cloud services for relay servers. Free tier available; paid tiers for production. AppKit has similar model.

5.question: Why the rebrand?
5.answer: WalletConnect Inc became Reown to reflect expanded offerings beyond the protocol. WalletConnect protocol keeps its name; Reown is the company offering full solutions.
